capabilities: Add named folder nodes to the graph view
Link folder nodes into a tree structure
Hide manual links between files and folders
Hide nodes by file extension strings
Configure root node visibility and orphan display
extras: README includes important settings warnings (broken links, orphans, attachments) and manual installation steps; the Credits section references inspirations but the linked names are blank, so no related plugin can be identified.
intentEvidence: will modify your existing obsidian graph view to add named nodes for the parent folders
problem: Obsidian's graph view only shows links between notes, so the folder hierarchy of the vault is invisible in the graph.
summary: Graph view modification that adds nodes for parent folders and tree links so the graph mirrors the vault's folder structure.
